title: Find Special Substring of Length K
summary: Given a string s and an integer k , determine if there exists a substring of length exactly k in s such that: - The substring consists of only one distinct character.
statement: Given a string s and an integer k , determine if there exists a substring of length exactly k in s such that: - The substring consists of only one distinct character. - The character immediately before the substring (if it exists) is different from the character in the substring. - The character immediately after the substring (if it exists) is also different from the character in the substring. Return true if such a substring exists. Otherwise, return false.
constraints: Find a substring of exactly k copies of one character.
If a neighboring character exists before or after it, that neighbor must differ.
Equivalently, determine whether s has a maximal equal-character run of length k.
reference_solution:
def has_exact_character_run(s,k):
    start=0
    while start<len(s):
        end=start+1
        while end<len(s) and s[end]==s[start]:end+=1
        if end-start==k:return True
        start=end
    return False

hints: Partition s into maximal runs of equal characters.
A run already satisfies the different-neighbor boundary rule.
Return true if any run length equals k exactly.
Longer runs must not qualify because an adjacent same character would violate the boundary.
editorial: Longer runs must not qualify because an adjacent same character would violate the boundary.
